ANNEX D

Execution Version

AMENDMENT TO THE WARRANT TO PURCHASE ORDINARY SHARES

This amendment (this “Amendment”) is entered into as of October 9, 2026 (the “Effective Date”), by and among Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings LLC (the “Warrantholder”), Amazon.com Services LLC (the “Assignee”), and Flex Ltd., a public company limited by shares incorporated under the laws of Singapore (the “Company”, together with the Warrantholder and the Assignee, the “Parties”), for the purpose of amending the Warrant to Purchase Ordinary Shares (the “Warrant”), dated as of August 15, 2025, by and between the Company and the Warrantholder.

RECITALS

WHEREAS, the Company intends to distribute to holders of its Ordinary Shares, on a pro rata basis, between approximately 88.0% and 94.0% of the then issued and outstanding shares of common stock of Axiom Solutions International, Inc., a Texas corporation (“SpinCo”) (the “Spin-Off Distribution”), which constitutes a Distribution for purposes of Section 8(iii) of the Warrant; and

WHEREAS, the Parties desire to amend the terms of the Warrant to the limited extent set forth in this Amendment.

NOW THEREFORE, in accordance with the terms and conditions set forth in this Amendment, the Parties agree as follows:

 

  1.

Unless expressly modified by the terms of this Amendment, the terms of the Warrant shall continue to apply and remain in full force and effect. Capitalized terms not expressly defined herein shall have the meanings ascribed to them in the Warrant.

 

  2.

Amendment to the Warrant. Effective as of the Effective Date, the Warrant shall be amended as follows:

a. The following is hereby added at the end of Section 8(iii):

“Notwithstanding the foregoing, with respect to the Spin-Off Distribution (as defined in the Amendment to this Warrant, dated as of October 9, 2026 (the “Amendment”)), in lieu of participating in such Spin-Off Distribution as though the Warrantholder were the holder of all Warrant Shares, the Company shall cause SpinCo (as defined in the Amendment) to issue to the Assignee (as defined in the Amendment), in connection with and concurrent with such Spin-Off Distribution, a fully vested warrant in the form shared between the parties (the “SpinCo Warrant”), exercisable at any time on or before the tenth (10th) anniversary of the date of issuance thereof, for cash or on a cashless exercise basis, at an exercise price of $0.01 per share, for a number of shares of SpinCo common stock equal to the quotient of (a) the product of (i) 3,859,851 and (ii) the difference of (A) the product of the Closing Price and the Distribution Ratio minus (B) $51.28, divided by (b) the Closing Price, where the “Closing Price” is the closing price per share of SpinCo common stock on a “when issued basis” on the Trading Day immediately preceding the Spin-Off Distribution (and notwithstanding any other provision of the Warrant, such Closing Price shall be used for purposes of the reduction of the exercise price in connection with the Spin-Off Distribution); provided that if the difference calculated under subclause (ii) hereof is zero or a negative number, no SpinCo Warrant shall be issuable. The issuance of the SpinCo Warrant shall satisfy in full the Warrantholder’s right to participate in the Spin-Off Distribution under this Section 8(iii), and no Ordinary Shares or shares of SpinCo common stock shall be issuable to the Warrantholder in respect of the Spin-Off Distribution. For purposes of this Section 8(iii), “Distribution Ratio” means the quotient that is equal to the number of shares of SpinCo common stock distributed in the Spin-Off Distribution for each Ordinary Share.”

 

D-1

  3.

Assignment of the Warrant. Effective as of the Effective Date, the Warrantholder hereby Transfers and assigns to the Assignee all of the Warrantholder’s right, title, and interest in and to the Warrant, and the Assignee hereby accepts such Transfer and assumes all of the obligations of the Warrantholder under the Warrant. The Parties acknowledge and agree that such Transfer constitutes a Permitted Transfer in accordance with Section 4.4(a) of the Transaction Agreement. The Company consents to such Transfer and shall, or shall cause its transfer agent to, promptly record such Transfer on the books of the Company and reflect the Assignee as the registered holder of the Warrant in book-entry form in accordance with Section 2(vi) and Section 7 of the Warrant. From and after the Effective Date, each reference in the Warrant and in this Amendment to the “Warrantholder” shall be deemed to refer to the Assignee.

 

  4.

Condition to Issuance. It shall be a condition to the issuance of the SpinCo Warrant that the Mutual Nondisclosure Agreement, by and between Amazon.com, Inc. and SpinCo, shall have been duly executed and be in full force and effect no later than concurrently with such issuance. If the SpinCo Warrant is not issued concurrently with the Spin-Off Distribution, the Warrantholder’s right to participate in the Spin-Off Distribution under Section 8(iii) of the Warrant shall remain in full force and effect and shall not be deemed satisfied or waived.

 

  5.

Tax Treatment. The Parties acknowledge that the Company intends the Spin-Off Distribution to qualify as a distribution to which Section 355(a) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (the “Code”), applies, and agree as follows for U.S. federal, state, and local tax purposes:

a. If, in connection with the Spin-Off Distribution, the Exercise Price is reduced to $0.01 per Warrant Share, then (i) the Warrantholder shall be treated as having exchanged the Warrant, immediately before the Spin-Off Distribution, for the Warrant as so adjusted in a recapitalization within the meaning of Section 368(a)(1)(E) of the Code in which no gain or loss is recognized by the Warrantholder, (ii) the Warrant, as so adjusted, shall be treated as stock of the Company (and not as a right to acquire stock of the Company) from and after such exchange, and (iii) such reduction shall not be treated as resulting in a deemed distribution to the Warrantholder under Section 305 of the Code. This Amendment is intended to constitute a plan of reorganization within the meaning of Treasury Regulations Section 1.368-2(g) with respect to such recapitalization.

b. Any other reduction of the Exercise Price in connection with the Spin-Off Distribution shall be treated as an adjustment made pursuant to a bona fide, reasonable adjustment formula having the effect of preventing dilution of the Warrantholder’s interest, within the meaning of Treasury Regulations Section 1.305-7(b), and shall not be treated as resulting in a deemed distribution to the Warrantholder under Section 305 of the Code.

c. The SpinCo Warrant shall be treated as stock of SpinCo (and not as a right to acquire stock of SpinCo). The SpinCo Warrant shall be treated as having been issued by SpinCo to the Company and distributed by the Company to the Warrantholder in the Spin-Off Distribution, and the Warrantholder’s receipt of the SpinCo Warrant shall be treated as a distribution of stock of SpinCo with respect to stock of the Company to which Section 355(a) of the Code applies and in which no gain or loss is recognized by the Warrantholder.

d. No Party shall take any position for tax purposes that is inconsistent with this Section 5, unless required by a determination within the meaning of Section 1313(a) of the Code. The Company shall cause the SpinCo Warrant, as issued, to provide for tax treatment consistent with this Section 5.

 

D-2

  6.

Miscellaneous. Sections 10 (Governing Law and Jurisdiction), 11 (Binding Effect), 12 (Amendments), 13 (Notices), 14 (Entire Agreement), and 18 (Interpretation) of the Warrant, and Sections 8.4 (Counterparts) and 8.9 (Severability) of the Transaction Agreement, are incorporated herein by reference and apply to this Amendment mutatis mutandis.

1. Number of Warrant Shares; Exercise Price. This certifies that, for value received, Warrantholder or its permitted assigns or transferees is entitled, upon the terms hereinafter set forth, to acquire from the Company, in whole or in part, up to a maximum aggregate of [•] fully paid and nonassessable shares of Common Stock (the “Warrant Shares”), at a purchase price per share of Common Stock equal to $0.01 (the “Exercise Price”). This Warrant is fully vested and nonforfeitable as of the Issue Date, and no portion of this Warrant is subject to any vesting condition, performance condition, or forfeiture. The number of Warrant Shares set forth above is equal to the quotient of (a) the product of (i) 3,859,851 and (ii) the difference of (A) the product of the Closing Price and the Distribution Ratio minus (B) $51.28, divided by (b) the Closing Price, provided that if the difference calculated under subclause (ii) hereof is zero or a negative number, no Warrant Shares shall be issuable and this Warrant shall be null and void. For purposes hereof, the “Closing Price” is the closing price per share of Common Stock on a “when issued basis” on the Trading Day immediately preceding the Distribution.

2. Exercise of Warrant; Term; Book Entry.

(i) Subject to compliance with the Antitrust Laws, the right to purchase Warrant Shares represented by this Warrant is exercisable, in whole or in part by Warrantholder, at any time or from time to time on or after the Issue Date, but in no event later than 5:00 p.m., Seattle time, on the tenth anniversary of the Issue Date (subject to extension in accordance with Section 2(ii), such time as stayed if applicable, the “Expiration Time”, and such period from the Issue Date through the Expiration Time, the “Exercise Period”), by (a) the delivery of the Notice of Exercise to the Company in accordance with Section 16 and (b) payment of the Exercise Price for the Warrant Shares thereby purchased by, at the sole election of Warrantholder, either: (I) by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by the Company (such manner of exercise, a “Cash Exercise”) or (II) without payment of cash, by reducing the number of Warrant Shares obtainable upon the exercise of this Warrant (either in full or in part, as applicable) so as to yield a number of Warrant Shares equal to the product of (x) the number of Warrant Shares issuable upon such exercise (if payment of the Exercise Price were being made in cash) and (y) the Cashless Exercise Ratio (such manner of exercise, a “Cashless Exercise”); provided that such product shall be rounded to the nearest whole Warrant Share.

 

E-1

(ii) In the event any approval requirements or waiting periods are imposed by applicable antitrust or foreign investment laws or any other Applicable Law in connection with the exercise of this Warrant, Warrantholder may deliver a Notice of Exercise that is contingent upon obtaining such approval or the expiration or termination of such waiting period, and the Exercise Period will be stayed during the pendency of such approval or waiting period so long as Warrantholder delivers the Notice of Exercise before the Expiration Time.

(iii) If Warrantholder has not exercised this Warrant in its entirety, following each exercise Warrantholder’s book entry position shall be amended to properly reflect that number of Warrant Shares equal to the difference between the maximum aggregate number of Warrant Shares and the number of Warrant Shares as to which this Warrant is or has been so exercised.

(iv) The Company shall either (a) maintain itself, or (b) cause its transfer agent to maintain, in each case, books for the original issuance, transfer, and exercise of this Warrant in book-entry form. The Company agrees that it will accept instructions from Warrantholder for the transfer and exercise of this Warrant in accordance with the terms hereof, and shall not require the delivery of this Warrant, which at all times shall be in book-entry form, in connection with the transfer or exercise thereof. In no event shall Warrantholder be required to post any bond or incur any other financial cost related to the book entry existence of this Warrant.

3. Issuance of Warrant Shares; Authorization; Listing.

(i) The Company’s obligations to issue and deliver Warrant Shares in accordance with the terms and subject to the conditions hereof are absolute and unconditional, irrespective of any action or inaction by Warrantholder to enforce the same, any waiver or consent with respect to any provision hereof, the recovery of any judgment against any Person or any action to enforce the same, or any setoff, counterclaim, recoupment, limitation, or termination; provided, however, that the Company shall not be required to deliver Warrant Shares with respect to an exercise prior to Warrantholder’s delivery of the associated Exercise Price (or notice of Cashless Exercise).

(ii) The Warrant Shares so issued shall be deemed for all purposes to have been issued to Warrantholder as of the close of business on the date on which the Notice of Exercise and payment of the associated Exercise Price (or notice of Cashless Exercise) are delivered to the Company in accordance with the terms of this Warrant, notwithstanding that the stock transfer books of the Company may then be closed or book-entries representing such Warrant Shares may not be actually delivered on such date or credited to Warrantholder’s DTC account, as the case may be. (iii) The Company shall, at its sole expense, procure, subject to issuance or notice of issuance, the listing of the Warrant Shares on the Principal Trading Market on which the same class of Equity Securities are then listed or traded, promptly after such Warrant Shares are eligible for listing thereon.

If the transferring holder does not transfer the entirety of its rights to purchase all Warrant Shares hereunder, such holder shall be entitled to receive from the Company a new Warrant (in book entry form and subject to the appropriate cancellation of the existing Warrant in book entry form for the transferred amount of Warrant Shares) in substantially identical form for the purchase of that number of Warrant Shares as to which the right to purchase was not transferred. All expenses (other than stock transfer taxes) and other charges payable in connection with the preparation, execution, and delivery of the new Warrant in accordance with this Section 7 shall be paid by the Company, other than the costs and expenses of counsel for the transferor and the transferee. Any Warrant book entry issued hereunder shall contain a legend as set forth in the first paragraph on the cover page of this Warrant.

8. Adjustments.

(i) Subdivisions, Combinations, and Stock Dividends. If the Company at any time subdivides or combines its outstanding shares of Common Stock, or pays a dividend or makes a distribution on its Common Stock payable in shares of Common Stock, then the number of Warrant Shares and the Exercise Price shall each be proportionately adjusted, effective concurrent with such event, so that Warrantholder is placed in the same position as a holder of record of the Warrant Shares immediately prior to such event; provided, however, that in no event shall the Exercise Price be less than the par value of the Common Stock.

(ii) Distributions. If the Company at any time declares or makes any dividend or distribution to holders of Common Stock of cash, indebtedness, assets, or property, or of rights or warrants to subscribe for or purchase any security (other than a dividend or distribution covered by Section 8(i)), then Warrantholder shall be entitled to participate in such dividend or distribution, at the same time and on the same terms as holders of Common Stock, as if Warrantholder were the holder of record of the number of Warrant Shares then issuable upon exercise of this Warrant in full.
